apps.versionDescription: v1.3.3 — The swara editor Phrase card now carries its actions in the header, like the LoopLab Swaras card: round Play/Stop, a Loop toggle chip and the red delete trash at the top right. They moved out of the Setup card, which is now settings only. Includes v1.3.2 (Varisai seam fix), v1.3.1 (background phrase loops) and v1.3.0 (Varisai Practice Dock).
